== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Merc Sunlet (Japanese)|Merc Sunlet]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=67708 Japanese A New Hope source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(17, 1, 468, 622)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>c246d54a1c7360d419ae568542ade9a6ce9854a6aa96b067aea5fae80d4a72cc</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-5/53/Japanese-ANH-Merc-Sunlet-SWCA-67708.jpg Internet Archive item].
